title: Believe In The Silence of God
paragraphs: Crises are a source of growth and development. From this comes real growth. You only grow when you have to. Isn't this sad? We only move when we have to. That's why life sometimes shakes us to the point where we think God has forgotten us. I am working on a book for a publishing house, and as I was writing a sentence, these words flowed from my fingers. Let me quote it for you. You will see it in my upcoming book about faith. The Lord says: "Faith is believing in the silence of God."

What happens when he says nothing? Can you endure God's silence and continue to believe? Have you ever felt that God has abandoned you? certainly. You will experience such times again in the future. Jesus felt that. Father, why... did you ever feel that God had abandoned you? He didn't leave you. He is simply observing to see if she will believe him despite his silence. They took the house, oh God. Because I am watching you to see if your faith is in the house or in me. I can always compensate for your home.
Where is your faith? Jesus' favorite question: "Where is your faith?"
